# 🪄 Intelligent UI for DeepSeek Harness
English | 日本語 | 中文
> **Turn LLM responses into live, interactive mini-apps directly inside DeepSeek Harness.**
**Intelligent UI** is a plugin for DeepSeek Harness (Desktop & Web UI) inspired by ChatGPT's Intelli
gent UI and Claude Artifacts. Instead of generating static walls of text, the model writes markdown
embedded with interactive component tags, reactive expressions, and beautiful Mermaid diagrams. The
chat interface renders them in-place in real time as the response streams in.
## 📸 Screenshots

| 🧮 Interactive Cost Simulator | ⚖️ Interactive Tech Stack Comparison |
| :---: | :---: |
🎨 Themed Mermaid Diagrams with Rounded Nodes & Semantic Role Colors
## ✨ Key Features
- ⚡ **Real-Time Interactive Mini-Apps**: Sliders, number inputs, dropdowns, and toggles recompute fo

rmulas, statistics, and charts instantly inside your browser—no backend round-trips needed.
- 📊 **Ri
ch UI Component Library**: Over 20 built-in components including KPI tiles (`stat`), bar/line/pie ch
arts (`chart`), responsive layouts (`box`, `row`, `grid`), progress bars, data tables, badges, and s

egmented controls.
- 🎨 **Beautiful Themed Diagrams**: Automatically transforms `

| **Layout & Structure** | `<box>`, `<row>`, `<grid>`, `<grid-item>`, `<divider>` |
| **Typography &
Data** | `<title>`, `<text>`, `<caption>`, `<label>`, `<badge>`, `<icon>`, `<stat>`, `<progress>` |

| **Tables & Collections**| `<table>`, `<table-row>`, `<table-cell>` |

list}...{/each}`, `{@body ...}` |
## 🛡️ Security & Privacy
- **Sandboxed Execution**: Expressions are evaluated via a safe AST interpreter. There is no `eval()

`, `new Function()`, access to `window`/`document`, or network fetch access.
- **Local State Privacy
**: Interactive input state is saved per message in your browser's local storage. Values are never s

ent to the model until you explicitly click an action button.
- **Safe Resources**: External links o
pen via DeepSeek Harness's native safe URL handler. External images only load from model-specified H
epSeek Harness's native safe URL handler. External images only load from model-specified HTTPS URLs.
## 📋 Compatibility

- **DeepSeek Harness**: `v0.2.0-rc.1` or later
- **Tested Models**: Claude 3.5 Sonnet / 3.7 Sonnet,
GPT-4o / GPT-6.1, DeepSeek-V3 / R1
